sources.note: Town of Stockbridge, Town Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officials' and 'Appointed Town Officials' tables (terms with expiry years), and the 2026 annual meeting warning printed in the report (Article 1 elects the officers by Australian ballot): the report runs Moderator Kent Butterfield through 2026 and the 2026 warning elects a moderator, but the outcome is published nowhere official (the town's 2026 minutes sit behind its website's script-driven app), so the post is created without a membership (straggler)
